dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of smaller, high-intensity pixel clusters without distinct internal gradients, localized primarily along the lower lateral region and the transition area near the posterior flippers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric arrangement of prominent annuli centroids forms an irregular sequence of interlocking triangles and quadrilaterals extending from the mid-dorsal line down the lateral flank.
